name: Fixture Co
belief: Stories get made with people, not about them.
story: Fixture Co is a made-up studio used to test the skill.

positioning.audience: Small NGOs that need a film to raise funds.
positioning.statement: For small NGOs who need funding films, Fixture Co is the documentary studio that films with communities. Unlike agencies, we shoot on location with local crews, proven by 12 delivered films.
positioning.plain: We make documentary films with the people you work with.
positioning.promise: A finished film in 8 weeks or the last invoice is free.

values.name: Consent
values.behaviour: We show subjects the cut before release.

values.name: Craft
values.behaviour: We re-record audio rather than fix it later.

example_lines: We went to see for ourselves.

tone_map.opening: Thank you for working with us.

pitches.s30: We make documentary films for NGOs, shot on location with local crews, delivered in eight weeks.
pitches.s60: We make documentary films for small NGOs. We shoot on location with local crews, show subjects the cut, and deliver in eight weeks. Twelve films so far.

rules: Clear space = height of the F

imagery: Natural light, handheld, faces at eye level

dos: Use ink on paper for long text
donts: Put sun-coloured small text on paper
